fishing.method: Profiles say where the water matches what each species needs, not how many fish are there. Water temperature is the satellite map's; breaks are the strongest gradient within 10 nm of a spot, read as the temperature change across 4.3 nm. A cue met at most in-range spots that day is 'everywhere' and singles nothing out.

synopsis.text: At 1 PM, a 1023 mb high was 400 nautical miles west of San Francisco and a 1012 mb low covered the northern Gulf of California. A weak offshore land breeze is expected near shore during the nights and mornings, with onshore flow prevailing each afternoon and evening through Thursday. An intermittent coastal eddy will circulate Wednesday and Thursday. Weak westerly onshore flow Friday will increase Saturday. As a storm system looks to move into the region this weekend, winds and seas are forecast to increase on Sunday, possibly to hazardous levels.
At 18Z or 11 AM PDT, a 1036 mb high was 1100 NM west of Seattle. A significant storm is possible this weekend, especially south of Point Conception.

including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure

late mornings.

infrastructure in the warned area should prepare for rising
water and take appropriate action to protect life and
property. High tides each day will occur in the late morning.
